item.title: Advanced RSS Namespaces Explained
item.dc:creator: John Doe
item.description: Understanding Dublin Core, Content Module, and other RSS namespace extensions.
item.content:encoded:
Understanding Dublin Core, Content Module, and other RSS namespace extensions.

Namespaces allow RSS to be extended without breaking backward compatibility. This post explores the most common ones you'll encounter in the wild.
